Lung cancer patients with EGFR mutations often develop resistance to the drug osimertinib when another gene, MET, becomes overactive. Combining osimertinib with the MET-blocking drug crizotinib can help overcome this resistance, but monitoring MET activity during treatment remains challenging. Using a novel blood test called cfChIP, we tracked EGFR and MET gene activity in serial blood samples from two lung cancer patients.
